newsitem.title: FRANCE: Five ad agencies bid for France Telecom account.
newsitem.headline: Five ad agencies bid for France Telecom account.

text.p: France Telecom said on Wednesday it and the Finance Ministry had retained five advertising agencies to bid for the financial information account for the pending sale of a minority stake in the French operator.
The agencies are Euro RSCG Finances -- part of Havas -- IS Conseil, Media Finance, Gavin Anderson and CPM et Compagnie.
The account is both for the domestic and international markets and the winner will be announced at the end of October.

French telecommunications minister Francois Fillon said on Tuesday that 20 percent of France Telecom would be floated during the first half of April 1996, the biggest stock market operation ever in France.
He said France aimed to at getting more individual shareholders for France Telecom than the two million people Deutsche Telekom has set as its goal.
